A_observed.construction: the recorded batch exactly as it ran, guard installed

B_guarded_calls_removed.construction: per unit, remove exactly guard_rejections calls, priced at that unit's own mean recorded call cost (input+output).  Conservative: the guard may have re-served costlier calls than the mean, which would make the true no-guard figure lower
B_guarded_calls_removed.uncertainty: arithmetic on recorded rows, not a live replay: the count comes from the recorded rejection ledger, the price from the recorded per-call mean, and the guard also altered the conversation, so a real no-guard run is not provably identical

C_extra_calls_priced.construction: remove every call the plugin ran beyond its baseline (plugin calls minus baseline calls, per unit) at the same mean price.  This prices the run as if neither the guard nor the model's own repeats had happened; it is the upper end of the no-guard reading
C_extra_calls_priced.uncertainty: the model's repeat calls are permitted under design D and therefore are charged in any real batch; this figure exists to bound the guard's own contribution, not to claim a realisable cost

repeats_visible.note: the repeats the set-criterion replay found (autoscale r1/r2, one duplicate each) are the ones design D now permits

pre_registration_essentials.task_set: tasks/stage5_autogen/natural_tasks_r20_orderfree.json (four new tasks, frozen after the mechanism and guard are frozen)
contract: the first role must read all four frozen evidence sources at least once; the order is free and repeats are allowed
the second role makes one checkable decision and answers with the exact RESULT contract
pre_registration_essentials.quality_gate: the frozen r8 judge only: per task, strict and semantic success not below the baseline arm
pre_registration_essentials.cost_gate: paired complete provider tokens positive on the majority and in the batch mean; every repeat, remedy and guard request is charged in full; the cache only changes dollars, never token counts
report_items_not_gates: the same-work subset and its paired mean
pre_registration_essentials.failure_line: guard_exhausted above 3 of 12 plugin units, or a guard firing on a non-plugin arm, or any audit error, ends the batch
pre_registration_essentials.why_demoting_same_work_is_not_a_quality_: on these tasks the decision depends on the evidence SET, so 'did it read everything' is a quality question and 'in what order / how many times' is an experimental-control question: it affects cost, not correctness.  The quality criterion therefore never referenced the order.  Demoting the control quantities to report items cannot admit a wrong decision: the r8 judge still checks the facts and the decision.  Conversely, keeping them as gates made a correct answer fail on an irrelevant property, which is what happened on r17's confirmation batch and what this design removes
pre_registration_essentials.not_retroactive: r15, r16 and r17 keep their exact-order criterion, their recorded failures and their scores; this pre-registration applies to the r20 task set only

verdict: both no-guard readings are positive, so design D's cost side holds on this batch; the quality side is the frozen r8 judge alone
